source: Written 2026-10-14 from the verified Scryfall oracle text for every card in this list (fetched the same day) and this deck's notes. Printed powers (Y'shtola 2, Blood Artist 0, Vito 1, Sun Titan 6) are from the cached Scryfall card data. Cards a caption names are [[bracketed]] so clips.py checks them against the current list. Opponents' cards are placeholders, never named.

scenes.head: Y'shtola — Night's Blessed Control
scenes.sub: Esper drain-control: every big spell drains the table, and the drains draw you cards.

scenes.head: Trigger one: big spells drain
scenes.sub: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell with mana value 3 or greater, Y'shtola deals 2 damage to each opponent and you gain 2 life.

scenes.head: Six mana open: cast Rhystic Study
scenes.sub: [[Rhystic Study]] has mana value 3. Y'shtola triggers: 2 damage to each opponent, and you gain 2 life.

scenes.head: …then [[Teferi, Time Raveler]]
scenes.sub: Teferi is mana value 3 too: another 2 damage to each opponent. Each of them has now lost 4 life this turn.
scenes.say: Then [[Teferi, Time Raveler]]. Teferi is mana value three too: another two damage to each opponent. Each of them has now lost four life this turn.

scenes.head: Trigger two: the end-step draw
scenes.sub: At the beginning of each end step, if a player lost 4 or more life this turn, you draw a card.

scenes.head: Drain. Draw. Defend. Then loop.
scenes.sub: Four clips follow: the drain engine, the fortress, the win button, and the close.

scenes.head: [[Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose]]
scenes.sub: Whenever you gain life, target opponent loses that much life. Every point Y'shtola gains becomes a drain.

cards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

scenes.head: Cast Vindicate on their best permanent
scenes.sub: [[Vindicate]] is mana value 3. Y'shtola deals 2 to each opponent and you gain 2 — so Vito makes one opponent lose 2 more.

cards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

scenes.head: …and Vindicate still resolves
scenes.sub: Destroy target permanent.
scenes.say: And Vindicate still resolves. Destroy target permanent.

cards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

scenes.head: Absorb: the counterspell that drains
scenes.sub: An opponent casts a spell. [[Absorb]] is mana value 3, so Y'shtola's trigger resolves first: 2 to each opponent, 2 life for you, and Vito drains 2.

cards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

scenes.head: …then Absorb resolves
scenes.sub: Counter target spell. You gain 3 life — and Vito makes an opponent lose 3.
scenes.say: Then Absorb resolves. Counter target spell. You gain three life, and Vito makes an opponent lose three.

cards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

scenes.head: Blood Artist: every death drains
scenes.sub: Whenever [[Blood Artist]] or another creature dies, target player loses 1 life and you gain 1 — another Vito drain.

cards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

scenes.head: [[Delney, Streetwise Lookout|Delney]] doubles the engine
scenes.sub: If a triggered ability of a creature you control with power 2 or less triggers, it triggers an additional time. Y'shtola (power 2), Blood Artist (0) and Vito (1) all qualify.
scenes.say: [[Delney, Streetwise Lookout|Delney]] doubles the engine. If a triggered ability of a creature you control with power two or less triggers, it triggers an additional time. Y'shtola has power two, Blood Artist zero, and Vito one. They all qualify.

cards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

scenes.head: One spell, twice the drain
scenes.sub: With Delney out, one mana value 3+ spell makes Y'shtola deal 2 to each opponent twice. They've each lost 4, so at end step she draws you two cards.
scenes.say: One spell, twice the drain. With Delney out, one spell of mana value three or more makes Y'shtola deal two damage to each opponent, twice. They've each lost four, so at end step she draws you two cards.

scenes.head: Tax every attacker
scenes.sub: [[Ghostly Prison]] and [[Propaganda]]: creatures can't attack you unless their controller pays {2} for each creature attacking you.
scenes.say: Tax every attacker. [[Ghostly Prison]] and [[Propaganda]]: creatures can't attack you unless their controller pays two for each creature attacking you.

scenes.head: [[Norn's Annex]] adds a toll in life
scenes.sub: Each attacker also costs {W/P} — {W} or 2 life. That covers attacks on your planeswalkers too.
scenes.say: [[Norn's Annex]] adds a toll in life. Each attacker also costs one white mana, or two life. That covers attacks on your planeswalkers too.

scenes.head: Two attackers, all three taxes
scenes.sub: {4} for Prison, {4} for Propaganda, and {W} or 2 life each for the Annex. If they pay 4 life, Y'shtola draws you a card at end step.
scenes.say: Two attackers, all three taxes. Four for Prison, four for Propaganda, and one white mana or two life each for the Annex. If they pay four life, Y'shtola draws you a card at end step.

scenes.head: [[Teferi, Time Raveler]] shuts off instants
scenes.sub: Each opponent can cast spells only any time they could cast a sorcery, so they can't cast anything on your turn, counterspells included.

scenes.head: Teferi −3: bounce and draw
scenes.sub: Return up to one target artifact, creature or enchantment to its owner's hand. Draw a card.

scenes.head: Counter what matters
scenes.sub: [[Force of Will]] can cost 1 life and a blue card exiled from your hand instead of mana. [[Counterspell]], [[Absorb]] and [[Sublime Epiphany]] back it up.
scenes.say: Counter what matters. [[Force of Will]] can cost one life and a blue card exiled from your hand, instead of mana. [[Counterspell]], [[Absorb]] and [[Sublime Epiphany]] back it up.

scenes.head: Pilot rules
scenes.sub: Mulligan for 3 lands plus a draw engine or two pieces of interaction. After turn 4, don't tap out into an opponent's open blue mana unless the play wins or stabilizes.
scenes.say: Pilot rules. Mulligan for three lands, plus a draw engine or two pieces of interaction. After turn four, don't tap out into an opponent's open blue mana unless the play wins or stabilizes.

scenes.head: Three cards, zero mana, a loop
scenes.sub: [[Viscera Seer]], [[Sun Titan]] and [[Angelic Renewal]] loop for free. [[Blood Artist]] and [[Bastion of Remembrance]] make every lap a drain.

scenes.head: Sacrifice Sun Titan to the Seer
scenes.sub: Viscera Seer: sacrifice a creature, scry 1. Sun Titan goes to your graveyard.

cards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

scenes.head: One death, three triggers
scenes.sub: Blood Artist: target player loses 1, you gain 1. Bastion of Remembrance: each opponent loses 1, you gain 1. Angelic Renewal: you may sacrifice it to return that card.
scenes.say: One death, three triggers. Blood Artist: target player loses one, and you gain one. Bastion of Remembrance: each opponent loses one, and you gain one. Angelic Renewal: you may sacrifice it to return that card.

cards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

scenes.head: Renewal returns Sun Titan
scenes.sub: Sacrifice Angelic Renewal, and he's back on the battlefield.

cards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

scenes.head: Sun Titan returns Angelic Renewal
scenes.sub: When he enters, return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard. Renewal is mana value 2.

cards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

scenes.head: Same board. Repeat.
scenes.sub: Every lap is a death: Blood Artist and Bastion drain, and each life you gain is a [[Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose|Vito]] drain. Loop until the table is at 0.
scenes.say: Same board. Repeat. Every lap is a death: Blood Artist and Bastion drain, and each life you gain is a [[Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose|Vito]] drain. Loop until the table is at zero.

cards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

scenes.head: Protect the loop
scenes.sub: Instant-speed removal mid-loop can break the chain. With [[Teferi, Time Raveler|Teferi]] out, opponents can't cast spells on your turn.

cards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

scenes.head: [[Bloodchief Ascension]]: the second engine
scenes.sub: At each end step, if an opponent lost 2 or more life this turn, you may add a quest counter. One Y'shtola trigger is enough.

scenes.head: Three counters: their graveyard bleeds
scenes.sub: Whenever a card is put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, you may have that player lose 2 life, and you gain 2. A countered spell counts.

scenes.head: Find the missing piece
scenes.sub: [[Diabolic Tutor]] puts any card into your hand: Seer, Titan or Renewal. [[Mystical Tutor]] puts an instant or sorcery on top, like [[Exsanguinate]].

scenes.head: Plan B: build the mana
scenes.sub: [[Dark Ritual]]: add {B}{B}{B}. [[Lotho, Corrupt Shirriff|Lotho]]: whenever a player casts their second spell each turn, you lose 1 life and make a Treasure.
scenes.say: Plan B: build the mana. [[Dark Ritual]] adds three black. [[Lotho, Corrupt Shirriff|Lotho]]: whenever a player casts their second spell each turn, you lose one life and make a Treasure.

scenes.head: [[Exsanguinate]]: each opponent loses X
scenes.sub: You gain life equal to the total lost this way, and [[Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose|Vito]] makes one opponent lose that total too.

cards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

scenes.head: Nobody gets to answer
scenes.sub: [[Samut, Tyrant of Naktamun|Samut]]: your instants and sorceries have split second. While Exsanguinate is on the stack, no one can cast spells or activate non-mana abilities.

cards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

scenes.head: Y'shtola — Night's Blessed Control
scenes.sub: Bracket 4 · counter what matters, tax the rest, drain the table, then present the loop. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
scenes.say: Y'shtola, Night's Blessed Control. Bracket four. Counter what matters, tax the rest, drain the table, then present the loop. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
